capabilities: Render html-effect code blocks (compare, timeline, diagram, report, slides) inside notes
Open and render .html files with relative-path images rewritten to Obsidian resource URLs
Edit HTML source in-app and save back to the original file
Export the current note as a standalone themed HTML file
Insert html-effect template code blocks via quick commands
disambiguation: Not a general web-page browser; it renders html-effect template blocks in notes and local .html files from the vault.
extras: Bilingual English/Chinese documentation; requires Obsidian 1.8.7 or later; changelog notes that the preview iframe sandbox allows scripts, forms, modals and downloads, and that a <meta name="he-no-zoom"> tag disables the zoom wrapper.
problem: Obsidian cannot render spatial HTML layouts natively, shows only source code for standalone .html files, and fails to load relative-path images inside those files.
summary: Renders spatial HTML content in notes via html-effect code blocks and adds an HTML file viewer with image-path fixing, in-app editing and note export.
